name: mcporter-plugin
description: Use MCP servers through the mcporter CLI and saved scripts instead of native MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Call MCP servers through mcporter scripts.
interface.longDescription: Moves configured MCP servers into mcporter, then has the agent call them through the mcporter CLI and saved deterministic scripts instead of one native tool call per turn.
defaultPrompt: Set up mcporter for my MCP servers.
